paragraphs: Happiest Birthday, my love wish you a lot of success and luck for your upcoming life meri pyaru rainnyy kaduuu. May all your problems family problems and the problems you dont tell to me may all that get resolved.

thiku hai meri pyari kadu, uble hue allooo, uble hue ande, baingan, matke, basuu baki name ni bolunag aaj ke din heheheehheeh.

chapter5.title: Reasons Why I Love You
chapter5.subtitle: I could write a library of volumes, but here are the little truths I hold closest to my chest.

reasons.title: The Way You Laugh With Your Whole Body
reasons.description: It's impossible not to smile when your genuine laughter fills the room it cures even my darkest days.

reasons.title: How You do the dootpan with me
reasons.description: I love the childish side of yours rainy and when you express it to me.

reasons.title: How You support me in everything.
reasons.description: No matter from which problem i am going through you are always there

chapter6.title: Every Second With You
chapter6.subtitle: Since July 18, 2025, every moment has been a little more beautiful because you're in my life.
chapter6.bottomNote: Every second, my favourite chapter continues. ♡

chapter7.title: The Final Reveal
chapter7.subtitle: Before we blow out the candles, a cinematic tapestry of you.
chapter7.montageQuote: To the girl who turned me into an emotional guy
chapter7.finalMessage: No matter where the roads take us, no matter how many years tick by, my heart will always choose you. Happy Birthday, Rainy. Here's to us, to love, and to a lifetime of adventures.
